measurements.evidence: The dining hall serves about 3,850 meals a day and features a stir-fry grill, stone hearth–style Neapolitan pizza ovens—which run on electricity—a salad bar, an international section, gluten-free options, a deli and soup station, and a soft-serve station.

It may not be as tall as StuVi I and II, have the convenience of proximity to central campus like Warren Towers, or the charm of Bay State Road’s brownstones, but there’s a lot to recommend the three dorms comprising West Campus: Rich, Sleeper, and Claflin Halls. First, they’re a stone’s throw from Case Gym, the Track & Tennis Center, and FitRec. Then there are the killer views—of Nickerson Field and the Boston skyline. And finally, there’s the campus dining hall— Fresh Food Co. at West Campus , which seats 840 and has more than 20 food stations, including vegan and Halal options and the famous West Burger, all of which helped earned it the moniker “West Is Best.”

Finally, there’s the two-story dining room, called the Fresh Food Company at Marciano Commons . A cross-campus sibling to the Fresh Food Company at West Campus , this dining hall seats 920 (and serves around 5,000 meals every day) and replaces the older dining halls at three nearby residences. The space has 12 dining stations for every meal, healthy menu options from BU Sargent Choice Nutrition Center , digital menu boards with nutrition information, and two kitchens dedicated to vegan and gluten-free meals to prevent cross-contamination.

It takes a small army to prepare and serve the 3,000 breakfasts, 5,000 lunches, and 5,000 dinners that BU’s Dining Services manages in its three main dining halls each day. Add to that the 40,000 customers served in the George Sherman Union Food Court every week, and it’s easy to understand why it takes 550 dining staff and another 800 student staff to make sure campus dining facilities run smoothly.

notices.rawText: Among the changes is the return of After Hours at West Campus , the late-night dining program that closed in August 2025. The menu features familiar late-night staples, including French fries, chicken tenders, and pizza, alongside healthier alternatives such as salads and grain bowls.
West Campus Dining Hall kicked off its After Hours program October 14 with free food, games, and giveaways for students.
